FREE LAUNCH STRATEGY

Recommended itch.io pricing for this release:
- Select: $0 or donate
- Suggested donation: $2.00
- Optional note in description: ratings and feedback are appreciated

Why free / pay-what-you-want:
This is a strong launch product for visibility, trust and early audience building. It is structured, documented and useful, but it is honestly positioned as a starter/reference pack rather than a full engine-ready UI kit. Free launch lowers buyer friction and can help collect downloads, ratings, followers and feedback for NexaVisuals.

Do not position this release as:
- Premium UI Kit Pro
- Complete Game UI System
- Engine-ready Unity/Godot/Unreal UI
- Figma/PSD source pack

Recommended future path:
After initial traction, release v1.1 or v2.0 with more components, states, source files or engine examples. At that point, consider $4.99–$9.99 depending on improvements.
